title: Enemy AI: Drones, Raiders, Mechs, Fear Constructs
description:
Purpose: Provide tiered AI behaviours for four enemy archetypes with distinct movement, attack, and reactions to player constructs, tuned for VR readability.

Behaviour overview and registrations:
- This module registers four behaviours exported on the ledger as: "ai.raider", "ai.drone", "ai.mech", "ai.fear". builtin.enemy_ai_hook instances in scenes should set behaviour_id to one of these.

Per-archetype frame logic:
1) Drones (robotic_drone_enemy):
   - Locomotion: 3D hovering with flocking (separation, alignment, cohesion) in open arenas; keep distance 6–12 m; strafe around the player; dodge when ring_beam_fx is sustained.
   - Attacks: short burst ranged shots with lead at low latency; color-coded projectiles from enemy_projectiles_vfx.
   - Crowd control: Tethers slow them; if caged, attempt breakout timer; if broken, stagger briefly.
2) Raiders (alien_raider_enemy):
   - Ground cover-based behaviour: move between cover nodes, peek to fire, charge for melee when close. Use grenades occasionally (telegraphed arc).
   - React to barrier walls (seek flank path). If dome shield detected, focus-fire until crack visual near-break then reposition.
3) Mechs (heavy_mech_enemy):
   - Anchor behaviour: slow patrol and then set up at firing positions; shoulder cannon volleys with AOE tells; ground-pound if player is within 5 m on ground.
   - Weak points: choose aim points that expose glowing weak parts; react to heavy constructs (battering ram) with stagger window.
4) Fear Constructs (fear_construct_enemy):
   - Aggressive rushers with ring-drain aura: when close to the player, apply CRingEnergy drain aura params.value("fear_aura_drain_per_s", 2.0).
   - Vulnerable to focused will (sustained beam or reinforced cages) — reduce breakout timers when reinforced.

Shared systems:
- Perception: VR-friendly cone checks with clear telegraphs; prefer large arcs for melees and projectile tracers for ranged.
- Navigation: 2D navmesh for ground, 3D volumes for drones; avoid no-fly zones.
- Damage/stagger: Integrate with builtin.health_damage; apply stagger tags when hit by CC constructs.
- Difficulty scaling: Read CMasteryProfile to vary group sizes and cadence.

Quest 3 bindings: none; AI runs autonomously.

Components read/write:
- Reads CTransform, CPhysics, builtin.health_damage, tags per enemy type, constructs via CTag{"placed_construct"}, CRingEnergy (for aura effects).
- Writes CSteeringTarget, CFireCommand (burst timings), CCooldowns, and CEnemyState enumerations.

Comfort/safety:
- Limit flanking to not teleport behind player; prefer readable paths. Keep projectile speeds readable.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_orbital_dogfight, test_alien_city_objectives, test_oa_defense_finale: enemies exhibit behaviours per archetype, respect CC, and fear aura drains ring.

Assets/scenes: robotic_drone_enemy, alien_raider_enemy, heavy_mech_enemy, fear_construct_enemy across all combat scenes.

Suggested file split: enemy_ai_register.cpp, ai_drone.cpp, ai_raider.cpp, ai_mech.cpp, ai_fear.cpp
